items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: That was my professor. He teached me

ctx.x: Yep, brass band. Was that the same one that Jim Robinson told us about, that they had old man Jim Humphrey came down as a teacher? Old man Jim Humphrey.
Valorant of Liberty. That's why he was. That was my professor. He teached me eyes and bones, pure ants and all of us.
Did you say that band was called the Elks? The Elks. Yeah. Elks brass band. That's right.
